title: What does "Weaponized" mean in this report?
description: The 2026 VulnCheck Exploit Intelligence Report analyzes vulnerability exploitation trends in 2025, distinguishing between 'weaponized' and 'exploited' CVEs. 'Weaponized' CVEs refer to vulnerabilities for which exploit code or tools have been developed and made available, while 'exploited' CVEs are those actually used in attacks in the wild. The report highlights that only about 1% of disclosed vulnerabilities were exploited, but those exploited caused significant impact. It also discusses the rise of AI-generated exploit code increasing noise in risk assessments and the evolving tactics of threat actors, including ransomware groups and nation-linked actors. The report aims to help organizations prioritize real threats over misleading signals.
